title: totalfloat query --json
description: A page of activities. Values are the results stored in the file. Empty values are null. Rows hold only the requested columns.

baseline.description: With --baseline: how this file's activities matched the baseline's, by Activity ID.

projects.description: The baseline's projects compared, by proj_id.

earned_value_total.description: With an earned value column: totals over every matching activity, before paging. With --wbs, the node and everything under it.

unmeasured.description: Activities left out, spending included, because their WBS node's earned value technique isn't one yet known.

cost_accounts.description: With --by-cost-account: the matching activities' assignment and expense costs by the cost account they're booked to, before paging. Each account holds only the costs booked to it, and accounts under it have their own entries; costs booked to none come last, with a null account.

account.description: The account's path: its short names from the top of the tree down, joined by dots (`1.3`); null for costs booked to none.

parent.description: The path of the account it sits under.

^udf:.description: An activity's user-defined field value, by the field's label or ID.

^code:.description: The value an activity holds of an activity code type, by the type's name.

wbs_path.description: The WBS node's codes from the top of the tree, joined with `.`

codes.description: Activity code values as TYPE=VALUE, comma separated.

resources.description: Assigned resources by short name, comma separated.

cost_accounts.description: The cost accounts the activity's assignment and expense costs are booked to, by path (short names from the top down, joined by dots), comma separated.

roles.description: The roles assignments fill, by short name, comma separated, including assignments by role with no resource.

float_path_order.description: The activity's place on its float path, counting from the earliest.

percent_complete.description: Percent complete by the activity's percent complete type: duration, physical or units.

duration_percent.description: Original less remaining duration, over original. Finished work is 100.

units_percent.description: Actual over actual plus remaining labor and nonlabor units. Null with no units.

budgeted_units.description: Labor and nonlabor hours over the activity's assignments. Null with none.

budgeted_cost.description: Summed over the activity's assignments and expenses. Null with neither.

budgeted_expense_cost.description: Over the activity's expenses alone. Null with no assignments or expenses.

budget_at_completion.description: Earned value (TF-041): the budgeted cost of the activity's assignments and expenses. Null with neither.

planned_value.description: The planned budget for work due by the data date, from the baseline's planned dates with --baseline, or the activity's own.

earned_value.description: The budget for work done, by the WBS node's earned value technique.

estimate_to_complete.description: By the WBS node's estimate method.

estimate_at_completion.description: Actual cost plus estimate to complete.

baseline_start.description: With --baseline: the baseline's actual or else early start.

baseline_finish.description: With --baseline: the baseline's actual or else early finish.

baseline_duration_hours.description: With --baseline: the baseline's duration at completion (actual plus remaining).

start_variance_hours.description: Baseline start less current start, in working hours on the activity's calendar. Negative is late.

finish_variance_hours.description: Baseline finish less current finish, in working hours. Negative is late.

duration_variance_hours.description: Baseline duration less current duration, both at completion (actual plus remaining), in working hours.
